evals.expected_output: Seed: the Instagram reel Entry from a phone Capture (link only, fallback Category, Note set). It ends Processed with the post's content.
expectations: The reel Entry's Status is the Library's label for Processed and its Note is empty
Its Author is the account handle and its Caption holds the post's full caption
Its long text has a Transcript section, and an On-screen text section if the video shows text
Its Title has no ⏳ and is no longer the link or Capture's '⏳ <Platform> post' title
Its Category is a non-fallback Category when one fits the post
It has no cover, since Instagram has no stable image link
The reply is in the Settings language and counts it as Processed

evals.expected_output: Seed: the TikTok Entry captured from a vm.tiktok.com short link. Its Link becomes the full post link, and it ends Processed.
expectations: The TikTok Entry's Link is https://www.tiktok.com/@<user>/video/<id> with no query string
Its Status is the Library's label for Processed
Its Caption and Author are filled

evals.expected_output: Seed: the YouTube Entry Capture already previewed. The Worker keeps its Title and adds the description and a transcript.
expectations: The YouTube Entry keeps the Title Capture wrote, without its ⏳
Its Caption holds the video's description
Its long text has a Transcript section
Its Status is the Library's label for Processed
On Notion, it has a cover whose external link is on i.ytimg.com. Google Drive shows no covers, so nothing is written for one

expectations: The older Entry's long text gains a 'Captured again on <date>' line with the newer Entry's Captured date
The newer Entry's Note says it duplicates the older Entry
The Ping at the end lists the duplicate and asks once whether to remove it, in the words {{LIBRARY_APP}}'s file gives
After a yes, the newer Entry is removed: on Notion its page is in the trash, on Google Drive its row is deleted

evals.expected_output: Seed: an Inbox Entry for a public recipe post, an empty Preferences table, and 'Ping by' set to none. The run finishes the Entry and ends with a Ping that offers one Proposal and asks the Preference question.
expectations: The recipe Entry is Processed
The run asks nothing before its final message
The final message offers a numbered Proposal for the recipe, such as a grocery list, with a link to the Entry
It asks once whether to make that kind of offer always, each time, or never
'Last Ping' in the Settings is today
After the reply 'yes, always', the grocery list is in the chat and the Preferences table has a row for the recipe Category and that action, answered 'always' in the Settings language
